verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents self-hosting as a single dependency-free binary for Linux, macOS and Windows. It installs via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT or source, with official Docker images, Helm charts and production guidance. Community reports independently confirm self-hosted runs on Hetzner boxes, k8s clusters and Coolify Docker installs. Missing for 10: evidence that the replicated/high-availability configuration is available to self-hosters (community notes it isn't in the free tier), and no explicit open-source licensing evidence in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
Install Meilisearch locally on Linux, macOS, or Windows using cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source.
Helm charts for deploying Meilisearch on Kubernetes.
A self-hoster runs ~80M documents (191GB, 13 indexes) on a 64GB Hetzner box
